**Finding: deviation (EXCLUSIVITY) — Section 2.2 (p0013)**

Section 2.2 made Vendor Customer's "sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term" — full-term exclusive dealing with no 12-month limit and no automatic exit for service-level or delivery-date failures, i.e. walk-away territory rather than fallback. It also contradicts Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no exclusivity commitment; the precedence rule in the second Section 2.2 addresses only Order Form/exhibit conflicts.

Redline (preferred level, validated ok:true): a single surgical replacement making Vendor "a non-exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term," preserving all other wording and eliminating the internal conflict. Section 12.4's non-compete is a separate restrictive covenant and was not flagged under this rule.
